dgp: X=1+.8*sin(.37*t)+.3*e; B=1 if e>0 else 0; Y=3+2*X[t-1]+.5*B[t-1]+.3*e; V=1+X[t-1]-B[t-1]+.3*e; t=0..399; e=sum of 12 uniforms minus 6 from one 64-bit LCG stream (B_t, X_t, then Y_t, then V_t for t>0)

oracle.method: linear lag-one law in `dgp`: the structural slope of Y_t on X_{t-1} is its coefficient 2, so the point derivative, the unit-step difference of the identified levels and the average derivative equal 2; the level 3.25 + 2x averages the alternating B; the elasticity, semi-elasticities, Jacobian and directional derivative follow from the coefficients at x = 1
asserted_outputs: point, elasticity, semi_treatment, semi_outcome, average (published value and finite difference of levels), the planted off-support point
context_only_outputs: jacobian and directional (carried for the reference; the refuter states assert the scalar coordinates)
fixture_id and dgp text (checked only as a guard on the model used)
